title: LocusEventV1
description: Versioned wire schema for events Locus emits and hubs (Phantom's router) consume. One event validates against exactly one $defs member; consumers dispatch on the discriminant (`schema` for audit envelopes, `kind` for heartbeat ticks). Values-free on every surface: ops, digests, aliases, grant/session ids and verdicts only, never credential refs or resolved secrets. Emitted by `locus events export` (JSONL lines and webhook body, $defs.audit), `locus-mcp` GET /mcp/sse `notifications/message` params.data ($defs.sessionTick) and `locus watch --json` NDJSON ($defs.watchTick).

audit.title: LocusAuditEventV1
audit.description: One line of `locus events export` (fleet pulse JSONL; same body lines POSTed to a configured audit webhook). Envelope around one $LOCUS_HOME/audit/events.jsonl record.

schema.description: Envelope schema id; router dispatch key.

exported_at.description: RFC 3339 export time (same for every line in one export).

ts.description: RFC 3339 time the audited op was recorded.

op.description: Audited op, e.g. session.pin, mcp.scope_freeze, binding.save. Open set; do not dispatch on a closed enum.

binding.description: Binding alias the op ran against; empty string for global ops.

detail.description: Per-op metadata: digests, ids, counts, tool names only. Never raw args, tokens or credential refs.

sessionTick.title: LocusSessionTickV1
sessionTick.description: params.data payload of the JSON-RPC notifications/message streamed by `locus-mcp` GET /mcp/sse. Operator ticks omit scope/grant_id/issues; tenant ticks (X-Locus-Tenant-Token) carry all three and describe that grant only.

scope.description: Present only on tenant ticks; absent means operator scope.

grant_id.description: Grant the tick describes (tenant ticks only). Id only, never the token.

session_ok.description: True when doctor is ok and safe_next is ready for the described scope.

whoami.description: Binding alias of the verified pin; null when unpinned or unverifiable.

doctor_verdict.description: Doctor verdict for the described scope.

safe_next.description: Machine-readable next action (ready, proceed, enter, re_pin, remint_grant, init, doctor_fix, ...). Open set.

pinned.description: Whether a pin/grant is present for the described scope.

frozen.description: Whether runtime binding drift is frozen under the live session.

issues.description: Drift issue codes (tenant ticks only; empty when clean).

hint.description: Present on the store-unavailable fallback tick.

watchTick.title: LocusWatchTickV1
watchTick.description: One NDJSON line of `locus watch --json` (also `--once`). Compact session heartbeat derived from `locus verify session`.

session_ok.description: True when doctor is ok and safe_next is ready.

whoami.description: Verified binding alias; omitted when unpinned or unverifiable.

pinned.description: Whether a pin is present (whoami or doctor pin).

frozen.description: Whether runtime binding drift is frozen under the live session.
